display_information.name: Pollito
display_information.description: Fast team consensus inside Slack with automatic quorum closing and secret ballots
display_information.long_description:
Pollito is a Slack-native polling and team decision app designed to close debates fast without thread clutter.

Key Capabilities:
• Automatic Quorum Closing: Set percentage or count-based quorum targets. Polls close and announce results the second quorum is satisfied.
• Double-Urn Secret Ballots: Cryptographically unlinkable voting where voter participation is tracked without linking identities to ballot choices.
• Real-Time Visual Progress: Clean block character meters directly inside Slack channel messages.
• App Home Dashboard: Full workspace decision dispatch board to monitor active and past polls.
• 100% Free: Unlimited polls, responses, and members with zero fees.

slash_commands.description: Create a fast team poll with automatic quorum
